_comment: Stage 1 swipe-file account list for docs/launch-advice/x-trending-guide.md. Real handles confirmed via web research 2026-07-30; 'needs_handle' entries are categories to fill in once the fetch script's own search pass runs (twitterapi.io supports keyword/user search, not just known handles).

direct_competitors.name: Clawket
direct_competitors.note: needs_handle_confirm — open-source mobile client for OpenClaw + Hermes, App Store live, pixel-art 'Agent Office' UI. Closest direct competitor to Summit; study its launch posts and App Store review sentiment.

core_ecosystem.name: OpenClaw (official)
core_ecosystem.note: confirmed — ran the June 2026 iOS/Android launch that hit 1.5M+ views but landed at ~2.2 stars (buggy, hard-to-pair, unpolished). Direct proof point for Summit's 'first-class mobile flow' positioning.

core_ecosystem.name: Peter Steinberger
core_ecosystem.note: confirmed — OpenClaw creator/steward, now at OpenAI. Highest-reach individual voice in this niche.

core_ecosystem.name: Nous Research
core_ecosystem.note: confirmed — builds Hermes Agent, posts feature launches (Hermes Desktop, memory features) that consistently get niche engagement.

hosting_and_tooling.name: OneClaw
hosting_and_tooling.note: managed OpenClaw hosting with its own mobile app angle — adjacent product, not a direct competitor.

hosting_and_tooling.name: AgentClaw
hosting_and_tooling.note: managed OpenClaw hosting, no-code deploy angle.

hosting_and_tooling.name: ClawHub
hosting_and_tooling.note: skill registry for the OpenClaw/Hermes ecosystem — good source for what technical self-hosters currently care about.

hosting_and_tooling.name: ClawTank
hosting_and_tooling.note: comparison/review content for self-hosted agent tools.

recent_launches_to_study.name: OpenClaw mobile launch thread (2026-06-30)
recent_launches_to_study.note: the single most relevant swipe-file case study available: huge reach, badly reviewed. Pull replies/quote-tweets, not just the OP, to see what the audience actually objected to.

how_to_finish_this_list: The confirmed handles above are enough to run scripts/x-swipe-file.mjs once TWITTERAPI_KEY is set. To grow past these ~8 toward 50+, add more handles here as we find them (hosting providers' actual @handles, more recent-launch accounts, mid-size self-hosted-AI creators) — the script just reads whatever is in this file, no code change needed.
